definitions.explanation: Material used to protect goods during shipping — bubble wrap, foam, crumpled paper, cardboard fillers, and the like.

examples.japanese: {梱包材|こんぽうざい}を{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: To throw away the packing material.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}れやすい{品物|しなもの}なので{梱包材|こんぽうざい}を{多|おお}めに{入|い}れた。
examples.english: The item breaks easily, so I put in extra packing material.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{環境|かんきょう}への{配慮|はいりょ}から、{紙|かみ}でできた{梱包材|こんぽうざい}に{切|き}り{替|か}える{会社|かいしゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, out of concern for the environment, more companies are switching to paper-based packing materials.

notes:
{梱包|こんぽう} (packing for shipment) + {材|ざい} (material). Belongs to shipping and warehouse vocabulary; online shops use it constantly in product listings and reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梱包材|こんぽうざい}を{入|い}れる: to put in packing material
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}: cushioning material
- {梱包材|こんぽうざい}を{再利用|さいりよう}する: to reuse packing material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {包装紙|ほうそうし}: wrapping paper — decorative wrapping for a gift, not protection in transit
- {段|だん}ボール: cardboard — the box itself rather than what cushions the contents
